Element reference

Every element a v2 theme can place, with the conditions the launcher checks before it accepts it.

Everything here is theme API 2.0, except the nine elements that say since 2.1: status.activity, notice.launch, server.refresh, server.manageMods, mod.created, mod.publishedSize, mod.subscribers, mod.folder and settings.done.

Kinds

KindWhat it is
displayRead-only content: text, a number, a thumbnail.
inputA control that holds or writes state.
actionA button.
navMoves between views, or opens Settings.
noticeA launcher message.
listA list, its header and its rows.
blockA launcher-owned block, placed whole.

Where codes

CodeAllowed files and positions
applayout/shell.json, any view file, or layout/settings.json.
browserlayout/views/browser.json.
modslayout/views/mods.json.
settingslayout/settings.json.
serverAnywhere a server is the subject: a list.servers row, layout/modals/serverInfo.json, a container with "context": "selection", or popup.serverActions.
server-panelSame as server, minus rows.
modA list.mods row, or a container with "context": "modSelection" in layout/views/mods.json.
mod-panelA container with "context": "modSelection", not a row.
serverModA list.serverMods row.
modServerA list.modServers row.
workshopModA list.modFilterResults row, or a container with "context": "modFilterPreview" in layout/modals/modFilter.json.
modFilterlayout/modals/modFilter.json.
updatelayout/modals/update.json.
modalAny themeable modal file.
selectionA container with "context": "selection", not a row or modal.
popupAny themeable popup file.
popup:<id>That popup's file, layout/popups/<id>.json.

Placing an element outside the positions its codes allow is an import error.

Req codes

CodeRequired in
viewsEvery composition of the shell with the server browser, and of the shell with Mods.
views+settingsAs views, plus the composition of the shell with Settings.
browser / mods / settingsThat composition only.
rowEvery row template of the named list.
modalThe named modal file.
popupThe named popup file.
with joinEvery subject context that places server.join.

A required element doesn't have to sit in the file its requirement names: window controls placed in each view file instead of the shell still count. What it may not do is go missing. A layout file that omits a required element fails validation, and the launcher renders Neutral's version of that screen in its place.

Compositions and multiplicity

Multiplicity is checked over a composition, which is the shell together with one view, the shell together with Settings, a modal file, or a popup file.

  • display elements repeat freely.
  • input, nav, notice, list and screen-level action elements appear at most once per composition, so a control never fights a copy of itself over focus and a notice is announced once.
  • An action on a subject — a server or a mod — appears at most once per subject context. A server row, the server info modal and each selection panel can each hold one server.join.

Labels, wording and icons

  • Free labels: an optional element with a label part accepts the label option. It is plain text of at most 40 characters and becomes both the visible and the accessible name. Required elements never accept label.
  • Wording variants: some required elements offer wording variants instead of a free label, and the launcher picks the exact words for the current state.
  • Icons: an element with an icon part accepts the icon option in one of three forms: a launcher icon name from the list under Icons; a package image path (images/…, SVG or PNG), rendered as a decorative <img alt="">; or "none", allowed only when the element still renders a label.
  • display options: these choose between iconLabel, label and icon. With icon, the launcher's wording remains the accessible name and the tooltip.

notice Launcher messages

A notice renders only while its condition holds, and the visibility check measures it only while it is showing. Beyond these elements, three more notices are launcher-owned and never placed by a theme: the theme-fallback notice, the incompatible-theme notice and the Activation Safety Window.

notice.launch notice SINCE 2.1

Placed in
the shell, any view, or Settings · once per composition
Parts
tag, server, message, dismiss · States: warning, error, refused

A bar naming the server last acted on, carrying the same join warning or launch refusal as that server's server.actionNotice. A successful launch never shows here. Dismissing it clears the notice for server.actionNotice too. A composition that places it may hide server.actionNotice in list rows.

notice.update notice

Placed in
the shell, any view, or Settings · once per composition
Parts
title, message, update, later

"Update" opens the update modal; "Later" dismisses the notice for the session. It is optional, because the update modal and Settings also offer updates.

filter Server browser filters and sorting

The filter bar: one control per server filter, plus the reset button.

  • Popup triggers: filter.map, filter.tags, filter.region and filter.sort open popup.mapFilter, popup.tagsFilter, popup.regionFilter and popup.sort, with aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded. The trigger part is the chip that opens the popup.
  • Filter popups: while open, filter.map, filter.tags and filter.region render an inline popup part holding one option part per row: a checkbox box (map), a tri-state indicator (tags), or a leading clear row (region). filter.map's empty part renders "Loading maps…" while its list is still loading.
  • filter.mods opens the mod filter modal.
  • active state: map, tags, region and mods are active while they filter anything. Sort is active unless it is Players, descending. Ping is active below 500.
  • Hide toggles: labelled "Hide empty", "Hide full", "Hide locked" and "Hide offline". Default off, persisted, and cleared by filter.reset along with every other filter. The control role follows the control option: button is a pressable button with aria-pressed, checkbox has role="checkbox" and switch has role="switch". The box part renders only for checkbox and switch.
  • Sort keys: Players, Ping, Mods, Name and Map.

Label and value wording: labels are MAP, TAGS, REGION, MODS, SORT and PING.

ElementValue
Map"Any", the map name, or "{n} maps"
Tags"Any" or "{n} tag(s)"
Mods"Any", "{n} mod(s)", "{n} excluded", or "{i} in, {e} out"
Region"Any", the region, or "{n} regions"
Sort"{key}" followed by the direction arrow
Ping"{v}ms" or "Any"

Placed in

server One server

Elements that read or act on a single server: its actions first, then the display elements.

Formats

ElementFormat
server.gameTime"h:mm AM/PM · {multiplier}"; "--:--" when unknown
server.players"{players}/{max}", with "+{queue}" when queued
server.pingA number, or "—"; good ≤ 80, fair ≤ 120, poor above 120
server.modCountThe count, "—" for none, or "?" when modded but not yet probed
server.lastPlayed"played {relative time}" or a date; renders nothing when the server was never played, or "—" with showNever. With recentOnly it also renders nothing outside the Recent scope. With label: "" the "played" prefix is dropped
server.regionEurope, North America, South America, Asia, Oceania, the raw code if unmapped, or "Unknown region"
  • Readiness data: server.readiness and server.downloadSize read the data fetched for the selection and the server info modal. They are not allowed in rows, where fetching per visible row would flood Steam.
  • Offline servers: offline is added to every server element's states while the server didn't answer the last refresh, and its figures are then the last known values.

server.join action

Placed in
anywhere a server is the subject: a server row, the server info modal, a selection container, or the server actions popup · once per subject context
Required in
every row of list.servers; the serverInfo modal
Parts
icon, label, spinner · States: busy, disabled, playing, modded, needsMods, offline
Options
  • wording (one of join, fixAndJoin, default join)
  • display (one of iconLabel, label, icon, default iconLabel)
  • icon (icon name, a package image path, or "none", default play)

Runs the join, which verifies and fixes mods first.

Wording

StateWording
Idle"Join", or "Fix and join" when the variant is fixAndJoin and mods need a download or update
busyThe phase label: "Launching…", "Starting DayZ…", "Subscribing…", "Downloading…" or "Verifying…"
playing"Playing"
  • Disabled: during any operation, or while DayZ is running. The tooltip reads "DayZ is running. Quit the game before joining another server."
  • Icon: Download for modded servers, Play otherwise.
  • Selection: clicking Join never selects its row.
  • Visibility: the check measures the selected row's Join, but a visible server.join inside a selection container satisfies it, because joining the selected server always works. A focused-but-unselected row still needs its own.

server.actionNotice notice

Placed in
anywhere a server is the subject: a server row, the server info modal, a selection container, or the server actions popup · once per subject context
Required in
every subject context that places server.join
Parts
code, title, message · States: warning, error, success, refused, offline

Shows this server's current join warning or error, or the last launch result; a refused launch also carries refused. It is required in every context that places server.join, and a file that omits it fails validation and falls back to Neutral's version of that screen. It renders only while it has something to report, so the visibility check measures it only then.

mod One subscribed mod

Elements that read or act on one subscribed mod, in a list.mods row or a selection panel.

  • Selection: mod.select checks the mod for bulk actions; it doesn't select it for detail panels. Its accessible name is "Select {title}". Clicking elsewhere on a row selects the mod.
  • Formats: mod.tags falls back to the Workshop id when the mod has no tags; mod.size shows the size on disk to one decimal place; mod.rating shows "{up}▲ / {down}▼", or "—" when both are zero.

mod.status display

Placed in
a mod row, or a modSelection container in the Mods view · any number of times
Required in
every row of list.mods
Parts
label, progress, dot · States: ready, update, downloading, missing, notSubscribed, serverSide, disabled

"Installed", "Update available", "Downloading", "Not downloaded", "Not subscribed" or "Server-side". While downloading with a known total, the label part instead reads "{downloaded} / {total}" to one decimal place and the progress part renders as a bar with an inline width percentage; the state follows a 1.5 s live poll, but a live "ready" poll never downgrades an authoritative "Update available" row. The dot part carries the same status as the label.

settings Settings

The Settings screen: one control per setting, plus the headings that group them.

  • Required controls: every Settings control is required, and each saves as soon as it changes. They may sit in closed sections, and their labels, hints, placeholders and choices are the launcher's current wording.
  • Section and group text: settings.sectionTitle, settings.sectionDescription and settings.sectionIcon render the wording for the Game, Launcher and Theme sections; settings.groupTitle renders the checkbox group headings Window, Startup and Discord.

popup The themeable popups

Each popup has its own file, layout/popups/<id>.json, declaring its placement mode and its contents. A missing file means the launcher's default popup.

  • Option lists: popup.mapOptions, popup.regionOptions and popup.uniqueServerOptions are single lists of role="option" entries with a check mark on the selected ones. popup.tagOptions cycles Official, Modded and First person through include (✓), exclude (✗) and off. popup.sortOptions lists the server sort keys.
  • Empty text: "Loading maps…" for maps, and "No favourites or recently played servers yet." for unique servers.
  • Server actions in menus: popup.serverActions and popup.serverLoad may hold any server.* action, and server.actionNotice. They read the server their trigger belongs to.

Surfaces

A surface is placed whole. Its elements keep their own ids, states and parts, so CSS still reaches them; only its arrangement is fixed. Placing a surface satisfies the requirements of every required element inside it, and counts as one placement of each element inside it — so placing surface.filterBar and a separate filter.search in the same composition is a multiplicity error.

Lists

Every list follows one model: the theme declares the list's columns once, a launcher-rendered header shows them, and a row template places elements into those same columns.

  • Sort keys: a column may name a sort key only from its own list's set. Clicking that column's header sorts by it; clicking again reverses the direction. popup.sort offers the server keys Players, Ping, Mods, Name and Map, and lastPlayed is reachable only through a column header.
  • Row states: every row carries data-state, and rows are not focusable themselves — Tab moves into their elements. In the server and Mods lists, every second row also carries even, for zebra striping.

Empty and loading text. The empty and loading parts carry the launcher's wording:

ListText
list.servers"No servers match the current filters." after the first load; "No servers yet — the list fills in once Steam connects." before it
list.mods"Loading subscribed mods…", "No mods match the current filter.", or "You have no subscribed DayZ Workshop mods."
list.modFilterResults"Loading…", "Type a mod name above to search the Workshop.", "No subscribed DayZ mods.", or "No mods match."
list.serverMods"This server declares no mods."
list.modServers"No servers in the browser need this mod."

A theme may place its own theme text instead, by giving the list an empty subtree.

Modals

Three dialogs are themeable, and each one is a file under layout/modals/. Every other dialog is launcher-owned and takes only colour and type tokens: the destructive confirmations, theme import and export, delete-theme, Steam required, and first-run setup. If a modal file omits one of its required elements, the launcher renders Neutral's version of that modal.

serverInfo

File
layout/modals/serverInfo.json

server
Required

none: the modal is not about one row

modal.close, modFilter.apply, list.modFilterResults

Subject
none: the modal is not about one row

Icons

The names the icon option accepts.

alertTriangle, appWindow, arrowRight, ban, check, checkCircle, chevronDown, chevronLeft, chevronRight, chevronsLeft, chevronsRight, clock, copy, download, externalLink, fileArchive, fileOutput, filter, folder, folderOpen, gamepad, globe, inbox, info, listTree, loader, minus, moon, moreHorizontal, package, palette, play, plus, refresh, rotateCcw, search, settings, square, star, sun, thumbsUp, trash, upload, users, x

Not placeable

These are launcher-owned and never appear in a layout file:

  • the window's resize edges;
  • the theme-fallback notice, the incompatible-theme notice and the Activation Safety Window;
  • Steam required, first-run setup and the splash;
  • the confirmation dialog, and the theme import, export and delete dialogs;
  • everything inside settings.themeManagement.
